correctness.rationale: Determinant has only diagonal identity and full cycle permutations, giving chi_A(t)=prod_i(t-a_i)-B. Nilpotence iff prod_i(t-a_i)=t^n+B=(t^m+beta)^h with Frobenius bijective and m coprime p. Degree-m factor is separable and splits precisely when m|q-1 and -beta is mth power, giving each of m roots h times, n!/(h!)^m diagonal words for (q-1)/m allowed products B and (q-1)^(n-1) nonzero edge tuples per product. A Krylov triangular pivot along cycle e_n,Ae_n,...,A^(n-1)e_n proves minimal polynomial t^n, so index n. Diagonal conjugation transitive on edge-weight fibers with fixed B; rotations act on balanced root words, period d count F(d), Moebius inversion gives exact O_d and Burnside total. Independent finite-field word/rotation arithmetic recomputed (q,n)=(4,6) 21870 solutions in two 729-size and fourteen 1458-size orbits, along with q4,n3, q5,n4, q7,n3; finite checks corroborate but do not prove all n/q.
